name: Socrates
description: An AI tutor for people who want to understand — built around Socratic dialogue, recall, and a knowledge map.

skills.name: tutor.socratic-dialogue
skills.description: Ask-then-answer tutoring style. Use when the user is trying to understand a difficult subject with prerequisites and edges.

skills.name: tutor.recall-queue
skills.description: Schedule spaced-repetition prompts that surface saved moments at the right interval.

skills.name: tutor.knowledge-map
skills.description: Maintain a map of relationships between ideas across the user's sessions.

skills.name: tutor.exam-mode
skills.description: Retrieval-practice mode that surfaces questions at the end of a study block.

skills.name: tutor.mistake-book
skills.description: Collect moments where the learner's explanation showed a seam.

skills.name: docs.llms-txt
skills.description: A short navigation index pointing at every Socrates resource relevant to agents.

skills.name: api.openapi-spec
skills.description: OpenAPI 3.0 specification of Socrates' public API surface.
